channel.title: The Barbed Wire - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Barbed Wire (thebarbedwire.com)

item.title: Talarico Defeats Crockett in Democratic Senate Primary in Texas
item.description: Crockett and Talarico were generally aligned on policy, and both rose to prominence in large part through social media.

item.title: U.S. Rep. Tony Gonzales Advances to Runoff After Reported Sexual Messages with Staffer Released
item.description: Gonzales has faced criticism and calls to step down — including from within his own party — over an alleged relationship with a former aide.

item.title: From Minneapolis to El Paso, Every City Is Now a Border City
item.description: El Paso is “the Ellis Island of the Southwest.”

item.title: More Than 1,000 Voters Were Turned Away Tuesday. ‘Total Chaos’ in Dallas Raises Alarms of Worsening Voter Suppression.
item.description: As if election nights weren't stressful enough, more than 1,000 voters were reportedly turned away from polling locations.

item.title: Austin Is Banding Together After Sixth Street Bar Shooting. Here’s How You Can Help.
item.description: Here are the most recent updates on the Buford's Backyard Beer Garden shooting in downtown Austin and a list of some ways you can help out.

item.title: From ‘Kung Flu’ to the Matcha Craze, Asian American Business Owners Say It’s Been a Whiplash Six Years Since Covid
item.description: Global tariffs and racism — along with demand for Asian flavors — have created a complex environment for AAPI retailers since the pandemic.

item.title: Musician Carter St. Hogan Honed His Trans Identity in Texas Honky-Tonks Before Fighting ICE in Minneapolis
item.description: Which mustache would you choose? We sat down with Creekbed Carter and more queer musicians at SXSW to discuss their art and activism.

item.title: At Least 15 LGBTQ+ Businesses Have Quietly Disappeared in Texas
item.description: Since 2020, at least 15 LGBTQ gathering spaces — bars, clubs, Pride associations, and restaurants — across Texas have closed their doors.

item.title: ‘Life-Changing Money’: How the Houston Rodeo Is Leveling the Playing Field in Women’s Events
item.description: A breakaway roping event has created a surge in women’s entries in rodeo competitions: “It has changed the entire sport of rodeo.”

item.title: Don’t Call It ‘Self-Deportation.’ Moving Back to Mexico Felt Like Reclaiming My Life.
item.description: Calling the decision to leave the United States “self-deportation” undermines the autonomy that brought immigrants here in the first place.
